info.title: Kitty Shop API - Admin API
info.description: Rental shop admin API for staff & operations (kitty-admin-fe). Tenant scope comes from the authenticated shop membership. Monetary values are decimal-safe values.

shopCode.description: Optional when a user belongs to one shop.

newPassword.description: Use a unique passphrase/password for production.

ordersToday.description: Non-draft, non-cancelled orders scheduled for pickup today

paidAmount.description: Net completed, non-voided non-deposit payment amount: inbound payments less outbound refunds. Deposit movements are excluded.

collateralAmount.description: Actual deposit received; may be below the suggested deposit, including zero.

evidence.description: Optional evidence image, at most 15 MiB.

actualReturnedAt.description: Thời điểm trả thực tế (mặc định là hiện tại)

note.example: Đã hoàn cọc qua tiền mặt

returnDocumentCollateral.description: Xác nhận đã trả lại giấy tờ CCCD/GPLX cho khách (nếu đơn giữ giấy tờ)

outstandingAmount.description: Outstanding non-deposit order balance in VND

revenue.description: Net realized revenue in VND, excluding deposits

unitRentalPrice.description: Đơn giá thuê mỗi món do admin ghi đè (VNĐ). Nếu để trống, hệ thống dùng giá cấu hình.

inventoryItemIds.description: Optional physical item selection; otherwise backend auto-allocates.

rentalAmount.description: Rental amount manually acknowledged; not a payment ledger entry.

inventoryItemId.description: ID của món đồ (physical inventory item)

allowedDocumentTypes.description: Allowed document types for document collateral

maxDaysFromBooking.description: Maximum allowed reschedule days from booking

feePerItemPerDay.description: Late fee per item per day in VND

newRentalChargeFromLateDay.description: Day of late return when a new rental cycle charge is triggered

feeMin.description: Minimum special cleaning fee in VND

feeMax.description: Maximum special cleaning fee in VND

enabled.description: Whether customer loyalty program is enabled

rentalsRequired.description: Number of completed rentals required for reward

rewardRentalValue.description: Free rental value reward in VND

stackableWithPromotions.description: Whether loyalty reward can be stacked with other promotions

cashAmount.description: Cash deposit amount for this category in VND
